issues.title: V550J assigns raw/canonical wave roles by lexical sort order
issues.evidence: wave_values is a sorted set containing raw_wave and canonical_wave; builder passes wave_values[0] as wave and wave_values[-1] as canonical_wave.
issues.root_cause: Representation role is reconstructed from string ordering rather than explicit typed fields.

issues.title: J-branch logical IDs are transitively sensitive to raw source/wave spelling
issues.scope: V550J pattern identity -> V551J packet/component identity -> V552J join lineage
issues.evidence: V550J pattern_id hashes literal source and wave. V551J packet/component IDs include pattern_id. Across QRA display, survey-identity key, question-structure raw, and question-structure canonical representations already observed for CLOSED_35, 20/35 wave objects produce more than one V550J pattern ID with semantic/configuration inputs otherwise fixed.
issues.root_cause: A logical cross-run object ID embeds a presentation/native label instead of stable source-family/wave object identity.

issues.title: Physical source/wave identity is Unicode-normalization-sensitive
issues.scope: V550 shard IDs; shared substrate partitions; overlay/path adapters; historical bounded paths
issues.evidence: Active shard/substrate sluggers operate on Unicode code points without NFC/NFKC normalization. NFC Latinobarómetro retains ó, while NFD Latinobaro◌́metro replaces the combining mark with underscore. Other active naming surfaces ASCII-fold or ASCII-replace. A decomposed Latinobarómetro scope directory spelling is already present in repository authority material.
issues.root_cause: Physical identifiers are derived independently from presentation strings before Unicode normalization or stable machine identity.

issues.title: Alias-named authority duplicates can silently shadow one another
issues.scope: V550 family overlay and overlay-manifest resolution
issues.evidence: The active loader builds an ordered candidate list across source-family stems and wave aliases and returns the first existing file after validating only that file's family/wave identity. It does not enumerate all existing candidates or compare their content. Therefore two individually scope-valid but content-conflicting files are resolved by filename priority rather than conflict detection.
issues.root_cause: File discovery aliases double as authority selection semantics.

issues.title: Active question-structure authority depends on absolute local legacy-tree audit paths
issues.evidence: All 35 canonical_intended manifest rows point audit_csv to absolute /Users/matthewsmith/.../data/ddm_build/reports/source_structure_audits paths. The current ddm_build_copy builder dereferences those paths directly to build the 18,792-row question_structure_register.
issues.root_cause: Generated source-structure evidence is located by machine-local historical path rather than an explicit portable authority binding/content identity.

issues.title: Question-structure builder can publish partial intended source-wave scope as green
issues.evidence: For each canonical_intended manifest row, a missing or directory audit path causes `continue`. The only terminal completeness guard is that the assembled output is not entirely empty; write_outputs then emits status green_question_structure_register_written. No CLOSED_35 or 35-object completeness check exists.
issues.root_cause: File availability is treated as optional iteration state even for intended governed source-wave authority, and publication status is not bound to expected scope completeness.

issues.title: Pipeline lineage/replay uses a physical source-wave namespace incompatible with governed producer output
issues.evidence: The governed smoke constructs V550 shard IDs as family_wave with optional country suffix. Current resolve_pipeline_lineage._resolve_v550 searches for source.upper()+'__'+wave via a literal recursive glob. Its inherited automatic discovery additionally requires '__' and numeric/four-digit waves. The public wrapper delegates CLI main to the inherited implementation, so those discovery constraints remain live.
issues.root_cause: Replay reconstructs logical source-wave identity from an obsolete filename convention instead of reading/locating artifacts by governed identity.

issues.title: Standalone V550 validation entrypoints reintroduce the DB raw-wave/canonical-wave collision avoided by the main shard worker
issues.evidence: The main V550 shard worker explicitly preserves raw scope wave because the facet-ready view stores raw respondent wave and canonical rewrite can return zero rows. Both standalone readiness and source-structure-population entrypoints perform that rewrite when canonical_wave_label differs from args.wave.
issues.root_cause: DB-facing raw identity and semantic canonical identity are not separated in a shared typed scope object, so each entrypoint independently decides which string belongs in the wave column.

issues.title: Review-only overlay generation reconstructs source/wave identity independently of governed CLOSED_35 identity
issues.evidence: Single-wave builder exact-filters the current QSR on caller raw wave, so canonical/QRA labels can miss rows; its response-option context lookup is var_name-only. Batch builder carries a separate db_wave/qsm_wave/canonical_wave table including Asian W6 and LiTS 2006 canonical I. Outputs are explicitly HEURISTIC_REVIEW_ONLY/NOT_CERTIFIED, so no certified runtime leak is claimed.
issues.root_cause: Candidate generation resolves scope independently from the governed source/wave identity authority.
